method: R1 blind suread (subagent read text only, no md/rules)

facts.fact: Hattie和Julian一边喝可可一边拼猫头鹰拼图
facts.anchor: They have their cocoa and work on the owl puzzle.

facts.fact: Julian拼上最后一块并从已完成的拼图前靠回，露出满意的神情
facts.anchor: before he clicks the final one in place and sits back from the completed puzzle with a look of satisfaction.

facts.fact: Julian告诉Hattie霸凌者Bastion今天回来了
Julian说Bastion曾被停学，但今天早上看见他的父母和校长谈话
facts.anchor: “He was. But I saw his parents talking to the principal this morning.”

facts.fact: Julian抬起拇指划过脖子做出割喉手势，表示Bastion对他做过的动作
facts.anchor: He brings his thumb up and draws it across his neck in a cutthroat gesture.

facts.fact: Julian说没有告诉老师，因为除了他自己没有人看到
facts.anchor: “No. No one saw it but me.”

facts.fact: 被问到是否真的伤害东西时，Julian回答没有，只是伤害自己
Julian用小手握拳比划击打自己的大腿，接着是脸
facts.anchor: Julian makes a fist of his small hand and mimes hitting himself in the thigh. Then the face.

facts.fact: Hattie问Julian吃通心粉奶酪还是披萨，Julian回答要披萨且不要菠萝
facts.anchor: “So I’ve got mac and cheese or pizza, which will it be?”
